title: Director, Process Engineering
text:
**We're Not Just in the Packaging Business–We're in the "Wow" Business**
**Pregis is Hiring!**
**Why Join Pregis?**
Pregis is in the packaging business to protect what matters. We are committed to providing our customers and employees sustainable growth through purpose-driven innovation and customer-centric packaging solutions. If you are looking for a company that is thriving across various high growth industries and is innovative, customer focused, high integrity, believes in strong teamwork and collaboration, Pregis is the company for you. Check out the Pregis Purpose to learn how sustainability and social responsibility is at the very core of our company DNA.
 
 
**Director of Process Engineering**
**Position Summary**
The Director, Process Engineering is an enterprise leadership role responsible for defining and deploying Pregis' Process Engineering strategy across a multi-site manufacturing network. As a leader within the Operations Center of Excellence, this role will establish the vision, standards, capabilities, and roadmap needed to improve manufacturing performance, accelerate growth, and drive operational excellence across all business units.
 
 
This position serves as a key strategic partner to Operations, Quality, Continuous Improvement, Product Development, Supply Chain, and Finance. Success requires the ability to influence the organization, align diverse stakeholders, and drive adoption of common engineering standards and best practices while improving safety, quality, service, productivity, reliability, and EBITDA performance.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**
Enterprise Influence & Collaboration
 
 

* Lead through Influence - Partner with Operations Directors, Plant Managers, Engineering, New Product Development, Quality, and EHS teams to drive adoption of standards and best practices.
* Partner with Business Unit Presidents, Operations Directors, Plant Managers, and Functional Leadership teams.
* Lead through influence rather than direct authority to drive adoption of standards and initiatives.
* Build strong relationships across the manufacturing network to accelerate change and execution.
* Ensure engineering initiatives deliver measurable business impact.

Strategic Leadership
 
 

* Develop and execute the enterprise Process Engineering strategy aligned with Pregis growth objectives.
* Establish engineering standards, governance, and best practices across the manufacturing network.
* Build a multi-year roadmap focused on process capability, automation, technology adoption, and operational excellence.
* Serve as the Process Engineering subject matter expert to executive leadership.

Center of Excellence Leadership
 
 

* Develop organizational capabilities, technical standards, career paths, and succession plans.
* Create consistency in engineering practices while supporting the unique needs of individual business units.
* Deploy technical resources against the company's highest-value improvement opportunities.

Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement Manufacturing Transformation
 
 

* Lead network-wide initiatives focused on safety, quality, productivity, reliability, and cost reduction.
* Drive Process Engineering support for the Pregis Production System (PPS).
* Identify and scale best practices across manufacturing locations.
* Champion data-driven problem solving, process optimization, and continuous improvement.

Capital & Technology Strategy
 
 

* Develop enterprise process technology and automation roadmaps.
* Partner with Operations and Finance to identify, prioritize, and justify capital investments.
* Provide leadership for major capital projects, equipment upgrades, and manufacturing modernization efforts.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and manufacturing solutions that support long-term growth.

**Measures of Success**

* Build strong relationships so business units pull for support
* Improved asset performance, throughput, and efficiency.
* Sustainable EBITDA improvement through process excellence
* Process standardization across sites and businesses.
* Reduced waste, scrap, and conversion costs
* Improved process capability and product quality
* Strong capital project return and benefit realization
* Consistent engineering standards across the manufacturing network
* Increased manufacturing capacity to support growth

**Qualifications**
Education & Experience
 
 

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, industrial, chemical, manufacturing engineering, or related discipline, required.
* 15+ years of progressive manufacturing, process engineering, or operational excellence leadership experience.
* Experience leading engineering teams in a multi-site (>10 sites) manufacturing environment.
* Experience supporting large-scale operational transformation, capital investments, and manufacturing modernization/automation efforts.
* Proven success developing and deploying enterprise-wide engineering strategies.
* Demonstrated proficiency in Lean and Kaizen methodologies.
* Experience with SAP or equivalent ERP system, a plus

**Leadership Competencies**

* Expectation that the role can range from tactical on floor partnership with manufacturing facilities to strategic 3-to-5-year vision creation
* Strong Executive presence and ability to effectively communicate with all levels of the organization
* Strategic thinker with the ability to translate vision into execution.
* Demonstrated success influencing across functions, locations, and business units.
* Ability to balance enterprise standardization with business-specific needs.
* Proven ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing technical teams.
* Strong business acumen with a focus on EBITDA, productivity, and operational performance.

**Compensation**
The listed annualized base pay range is primarily based on analysis of similar positions. Actual base pay could vary and may be above or below the listed range based on factors including but not limited to performance, proficiency and demonstration of competencies required for the role. The base pay is just one component of Pregis’ total compensation package. The base pay range for this role is estimated to be $180,000 - $220,000, depending on experience and skills.
 
 
Compensation details listed in US job postings reflect base salary only and do not include benefits. Learn more about Benefits at Pregis.
 
 
**Travel**

* 50 to 75%

**Diversity and Inclusion**
We believe in diversity of thought and bringing together other traits and characteristics that make an individual bring a unique experience to Pregis. We strive to foster an inclusive environment where behaviors and social norms ensure people are welcome.
 
 
**Affirmative Action/EEO Statement/Inclusion**
We offer equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type based on race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. We support inclusion and believe in welcoming a collective sum of individual differences, thoughts, traits, and characteristics to represent Pregis’ culture and achievements.
 
 
Visit us at www.pregis.com for more information about Pregis LLC.
